conditions: Exact HashMap receiver with a stable valid table and node structures.
Non-null keys use Object.hashCode and Object.equals and do not implement Comparable.
TreeNode assertions must already be initialized and disabled.
Native identity hashing uses an inert 32-bit stub.
The loose instruction assertion is a test limit, not an admitted analytical bound.
Capacity, concurrency, initialization, native latency, and actual map limits remain separate.
